# Docs Impact Checklist

## Always Review
- README.md
- docs/README.md
- docs/examples/README.md

## Review If Relevant
- Component page under docs/ for touched module
- docs/ProjectBlueprint.md for architecture updates
- docs/AI_Assistants.md for workflow and prompting changes

## Migration Notes
- Describe behavior changes that can break existing projects.
- Include old vs new pattern with short examples.
